source_contract.manager_cpu_path: InferenceManager.__call__ routes CPU to _run_forward(_prepare_inputs(inputs)) before accelerator memory sizing and batch splitting (inference.py:1234-1297). _prepare_inputs moves tensor inputs and passes non-tensor values through (1210-1223). _run_forward retains no_grad, FA3 toggle, and optional AMP (1226-1232).
source_contract.output_repeat: output_repeat contributes only to output-size estimation on the later accelerator/offload path (1328); it does not change CPU forward values. The no-feature-group shuffle optimization passes output_repeat=B (embedding.py:654-664). Adapter preserves the argument and records it; when auto_batch=False or device is non-CPU it delegates to the original manager.
source_contract.manager_scope: Each ColEmbedding constructs its own InferenceManager(enc_name='tf_col') (embedding.py:183). TabICL wires this ColEmbedding into self.col_embedder and passes only COL_CONFIG (tabicl.py:240-256, 415-429). The adapter replaces only estimator.model_.col_embedder.inference_mgr and returns a restore handle.
source_contract.column_batch_shapes: Grouped path passes features as (B,G+C,T,group_size), with y_train expanded to (B,G+C,train_size) (embedding.py:580-606). Ungrouped path passes (B,H+C,T,1), with y_train expanded to (B,H+C,train_size) (608-644). Shuffle optimization passes (H+C,T,1) and (H+C,train_size), then applies duplication/permutation after the column embedding (646-675). The adapter derives the last leading axis before T/in_dim, slices features and matching target on that same axis, and fails closed on unknown tensor arguments or target shape mismatch.
source_contract.independence_and_context: _compute_embeddings applies the shared input projection, target embedding, set transformer, and affine output per batch item (embedding.py:340-421). Encoder/layer APIs retain arbitrary leading batch axes while attention operates on sequence positions; inducing attention uses only the first train_size positions for keys/values and returns all T positions (encoders.py:120-147; layers.py:406-454, 625-684). Chunking therefore preserves FIT/query sequence, grouping-internal width, feature order, and train_size/embed_with_test; full row interaction and ICL happen only after the full column result returns (tabicl.py:421-442).
source_contract.normalization: The adapter only narrows feature/target views, delegates unchanged manager preparation/forward, and stitches outputs by original column position. It does not change estimator preprocessing, fitted normalization/ensemble generation, tensors' values, or the context sequence.
